entries.title: Goblins of the Hills
entries.subject: goblin
entries.body: Small, quick and hungry. The hill clans fight with spears, short bows and ambushes, and they fight hardest for their children. A goblin who surrenders expects to be fed; a goblin who is not fed remembers.

entries.title: The Stock of Emberwick
entries.body: The farms around Emberwick keep patient mules for the grain road and small goats to browse the rough field edges. The mules carry sacks between the outlying steads, the mill and the town granary; a little brass bell muffled in leather lets a handler find one in the dusk without ringing across the river. The goats know every gate in the fences and crowd close to the reeve's warm-walled cottage when the evening turns cold. They are ordinary, stubborn creatures, and the people who tend them count them as carefully as the last good sheaves.

entries.title: Wild Neighbours of the Ford
entries.body: Rooks work the cut fields behind the scarecrows, turning over stubble for grubs after the harvest. Mallards settle in the quieter bends below the ford, well away from the toll bridge. At dusk a red fox comes down from Scarpfoot Wood to hunt mice along the old field edges. The farmers say the foxes have been seen closer to town since the hills began sending game down and the fields stopped holding warmth. None of them are omens; they are hungry neighbours, like everyone else in the Vale.

entries.title: Hobgoblins
entries.subject: hobgoblin
entries.body: Larger, disciplined cousins of the hill goblins, who join the clans in war years. Vorga's Host is built around them: shield walls, drilled archers, and no patience for bargaining.

entries.title: The Kindled Faithful
entries.subject: cultist
entries.body: Farmers, millers and widows from the hungry towns, armed with knives and faith. Most have never fought before. They are not afraid to die, because they believe the flame will remember them.

entries.title: The Risen of Frostpeak
entries.subject: zombie
entries.body: The dead of the pass, raised by the cold ember: Warden pilgrims, dwarven road-builders and goliaths of the lost holds. They walk the old roads they walked in life, without any memory of who they were. They are not cruel. They are empty.

entries.title: Bone Wardens
entries.subject: skeleton
entries.body: The oldest dead of the Wardens' crypts, still in the remnants of their uniforms, still keeping watch. Something in the crypts' wards keeps them at their posts.

entries.title: Wraiths
entries.subject: wraith
entries.body: What is left when ember-fire burns away every memory a person had. A wraith is cold, hungry, and drawn to the living, because the living still remember.

entries.title: Ember-Born Elementals
entries.subject: fire_elemental
entries.body: Fragments of the Hearthflame that have woken. Near a burning ember they rise as fire; near water, earth and wind they take those shapes instead, though they always remember being fire. They are not hostile so much as homesick.

entries.title: The Dragon in the Keep
entries.subject: dragon
entries.body: A great red dragon came to Ember Keep in the decade after the Fall, drawn by the heat of the flame's heart, and has slept coiled around it ever since. The Last Watch has never tried to move it. The Kindled are counting on it waking.

entries.title: Ashmaw
entries.subject: ashmaw
entries.body: A vast grey cave bear with coal-bright eyes and smouldering fur tips. Old warmth kept it sleeping; picks woke it, and hunger drove it out. A creature to pity, once it can no longer hurt the town.

entries.title: Grisk of the Diggings
entries.subject: kobold_foreman
entries.body: Helmet lamp, tally cord and a pick held like a promise. Grisk’s crew is paid by the pound. He shouts loudest when the stone behind him growls.
